claims.statement: The stated six-dimensional baseline has characteristic polynomial (lambda+1)^6 and the three listed zeros.
claims.limitation: Reproduction of a cited construction, not a new result.

claims.statement: The displayed factor-sharing compression has a positive Jacobian eigenvalue at the stated point.
The displayed parallel and chain formulae exhaust their stated bigraded monomial architectures after the stated normalisations and relations.
claims.limitation: Does not cover other gradings, changed base terms, zero feedthrough cases or unrelated architectures.

claims.statement: No member of the displayed 17-parameter parallel-auxiliary family has det(LI-DH)=L^5.
No member of the displayed 16-parameter unequal-weight chain family has det(LI-DH)=L^5.
claims.limitation: Family-specific impossibility theorem; the short contradiction uses nine selected affine-linear coefficient equations.

claims.statement: For nonzero kappa, r and t, the nonconstant Hessian coefficient matrices of the stated potential family span Sym_5(R), precluding constant trace after invertible affine source-target changes.
claims.limitation: Applies to the specified quadratic leading term plus perturbations affine in auxiliary variables and only to affine source-target changes.

claims.statement: The global five-dimensional weak Markus-Yamabe construction/nonexistence problem remains unresolved by this release.
